ad_info.reference_style: Bold editorial two-tone Q&A ad: a dark question zone with an oversized left-aligned question and a giant tone-on-tone question mark, a light answer zone with a short direct answer, and the product straddling the color split

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF.
global_identity.visual_style: Bold editorial two-tone supplement ad: deep magenta question zone, pale blush answer zone, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat solid color zones split by one straight line, a giant tone-on-tone question mark, a small outlined pill.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (heavy) for the question and the verdict, Poppins Regular for the answer, Poppins SemiBold uppercase for the kicker.

creative_objective: Voice the frustration of having taken aguaje without seeing changes, and answer it right away: the 3-in-1 formula and the complete 3-bottle treatment.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The oversized question in the dark top zone. 2) The bottle straddling the split on the right. 3) The answer with its bold fuchsia verdict. 4) The kicker pill.
art_direction.composition_style: Two-tone horizontal split: deep magenta top zone and pale blush bottom zone divided by one clean straight line. Left-aligned editorial grid with a strong text edge at 6% of the width. The bottle stands on the right crossing the split, frontal, at eye level. A giant faint question mark behind the right side of the top zone.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top zone 0-52% height; bottom zone 52-100%. Kicker pill 6-11% height from 6% width. Question 13-39% height, 6-90% width. Giant question mark 62-96% width, 2-50% height, behind everything. Answer 58-90% height, 6-55% width. Bottle 58-94% width, 42-94% height, crossing the split at 52%.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Both zones flat solid color; the question mark flat with no shadow; the bottle with a soft key light from the upper left, a subtle rim light separating its cap from the dark zone, a soft contact shadow on the light zone.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas split horizontally: a deep magenta top zone and a pale blush pink bottom zone. In the top zone, a small outlined bubblegum pink kicker pill at the top left, a very large bold white question filling most of the zone left-aligned, and a giant faint question mark slightly lighter than the magenta behind its right side. In the bottom zone, a short direct answer left-aligned in the left column with its first words in bold hot fuchsia. The user's bottle stands large on the right crossing the color split. No other elements.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 bold editorial supplement ad split horizontally into two flat solid colors by one clean straight line at 52 percent of the height: TOP ZONE deep magenta (#B0105E), BOTTOM ZONE pale blush pink (#FBE3EE), no gradient. TOP ZONE: behind everything on the right side (62-96 percent of the width, 2-50 percent of the height) a giant flat question mark glyph in a magenta only slightly lighter than the background, very low contrast, clipped at the split line. Top left, from 6 percent of the width and 6-11 percent of the height, a small rounded pill outlined in bubblegum pink (#FF8CC0) with semi-bold uppercase bubblegum pink text with wide letter spacing. Below it, left-aligned from 13 to 39 percent of the height, a very large extra bold white question in up to 3 lines with tight line spacing. BOTTOM ZONE: left column (6-55 percent of the width, 58-90 percent of the height), a short left-aligned answer in dark charcoal Poppins Regular, its first words in bold hot fuchsia (#E6177F). RIGHT, crossing the split line (58-94 percent of the width, 42-94 percent of the height), frontal at eye level, about half the canvas height, its cap and upper part over the magenta zone and its body over the blush zone, standing on the blush zone with a soft contact shadow, soft key light from the upper left and a subtle rim light separating its top from the dark zone: the product. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS'. No other elements. Include only these elements and texts.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the small pill at the top left of the dark zone

Poppins Black, very large (each line about 8% of the canvas height), max 3 lines, left-aligned, white
Poppins Regular, about 4.5% of the canvas height per line, max 5 lines, left-aligned, dark charcoal; 'Te faltaba el 3 en 1.' in bold hot fuchsia
text_layers.text: Te faltaba el 3 en 1. Aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra juntos, en tratamiento de 3 frascos.

final_generation_exclusions: No people, fruits, capsules or props
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
